rows.text: MM 2 Energy Transition and Innovation The government and TNB have made a clear commitment that there will be no new build-up of greenfield coal plants.

rows.text: Higher RE integration (especially solar) into the national grid requires timely investment to enable a smart and flexible grid system.
rows.source_sentence: Higher RE integration (especially solar) into the national grid requires timely investment to enable a smart and flexible grid system.

rows.text: On the demand side, electrification and energy efficiency continue to significantly contribute towards the nation’s energy transition journey.

rows.text: These initiatives align with our Reimagining TNB (RT) implementation that cuts across the electricity value chain, from transitioning power generation to Deliver Clean Generation and enhancing the Develop Energy Transition Network to enable more green solutions, to Dynamic Energy Solutions by enhancing customer experiences through digitalisation and electrification.
rows.source_sentence: These initiatives align with our Reimagining TNB (RT) implementation that cuts across the electricity value chain, from transitioning power generation to Deliver Clean Generation and enhancing the Develop Energy Transition Network to enable more green solutions, to Dynamic Energy Solutions by enhancing customer experiences through digitalisation and electrification.

rows.text: TNB’s ET journey is further strengthened with our active participation in the National Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR), which aims to reduce the nation’s carbon footprint.
rows.source_sentence: TNB’s ET journey is further strengthened with our active participation in the National Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR), which aims to reduce the nation’s carbon footprint.

rows.text: Three (3) of TNB’s ET projects have been adopted under two (2) of the NETR’s flagship catalyst initiatives, namely solar park and hybrid hydro floating solar PV under the RE Zone initiative and co-firing of hydrogen and ammonia under the Hydrogen for Power initiative.
rows.source_sentence: Three (3) of TNB’s ET projects have been adopted under two (2) of the NETR’s flagship catalyst initiatives, namely solar park and hybrid hydro floating solar PV under the RE Zone initiative and co-firing of hydrogen and ammonia under the Hydrogen for Power initiative.

rows.text: Distributed energy resources (DERs) such as rooftop solar panels play a pivotal role in creating a more decentralised energy landscape.

rows.text: Unlike the traditional one-way flow of energy from power plants to consumers through the transmission and distribution grid, this decentralisation introduces a bidirectional flow of electricity.
rows.source_sentence: Unlike the traditional one-way flow of energy from power plants to consumers through the transmission and distribution grid, this decentralisation introduces a bidirectional flow of electricity.

rows.text: The management of these dynamic energy flows necessitates the implementation of smart grids and Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI).
rows.source_sentence: The management of these dynamic energy flows necessitates the implementation of smart grids and Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI).

rows.text: In 2023, the Grid Division and Distribution Network Division invested over RM2.9 billion and RM5 billion of capital expenditure, respectively, in securing, maintaining and modernising our national grid.
rows.source_sentence: In 2023, the Grid Division and Distribution Network Division invested over RM2.9 billion and RM5 billion of capital expenditure, respectively, in securing, maintaining and modernising our national grid.

rows.text: The highlights of our smart grid initiatives include the facilitation of RE penetration into the system, expanding AMI and real-time network monitoring and control.
rows.source_sentence: The highlights of our smart grid initiatives include the facilitation of RE penetration into the system, expanding AMI and real-time network monitoring and control.

rows.text: Additionally, in 2023, we enhanced our efforts in realising the ASEAN Power Grid aspiration by forming strategic partnerships with ASEAN Member States in the region.
